steps.instruction: Pierce each of the 4 potatoes several times with a fork.
Microwave one potato on high for 3 minutes, until tender.
steps.spoken: Microwave each potato on high for about 3 to four minutes, until tender. Do this for each of the 4 potatoes.

steps.instruction: Steam 4 cups of frozen mixed vegetables until hot.
Mix 1 cup of sour cream, 1/2 teaspoon each of dried oregano and basil, and pepper.
Split the potatoes down the center.
Fill the potatoes with the steamed vegetables.
Top the potatoes with the sour cream and serve hot.
